title: Length of the dimming episode vs. time until an actual supernova (years)

source.name: Duration of the Great Dimming vs. Betelgeuse's remaining lifespan estimate
source.publisher: Montarges et al., Nature, 2021 (dimming timeline); standard red-supergiant stellar-evolution estimates (order-of-magnitude, widely cited in astronomy literature and by NASA/ESO as 'within the next 100,000 years')

notes: The dimming episode ran roughly October 2019 to April 2020 (about 0.5 years) before brightness recovered. Betelgeuse's actual supernova is still expected on an order-of-magnitude timescale of roughly the next 100,000 years -- an estimate, not a precise date.
